dialogues.speaker: Genzou
dialogues.text: Who are you? What is your business here?

dialogues.speaker: Genzou
dialogues.text: If you're a commoner, you should leave now. If my superior comes in and finds you here, you'll be in deep trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Mind telling me a bit about yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Genzou
dialogues.text: I'm just a soldier of the Shogunate. I am here on a mission with my superior.

dialogues.speaker: Genzou
dialogues.text: I'm just a nobody compared to my superior, Sir Terada. No one really not worth mentioning, haha.

dialogues.speaker: Genzou
dialogues.text: Leave now, and stay out of trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Genzou
dialogues.text: What's with the suspicious tone? You think we're impostors?

dialogues.speaker: Genzou
dialogues.text: I am a Shogunate officer, and this is my identification! Don't you dare be so rude!

dialogues.speaker: Genzou
dialogues.text: As for Lord Terada, his status exceeds mine. How can the likes of you question his authority?

dialogues.speaker: Genzou
dialogues.text: He is a humble man with many accomplishments, and he treats his subordinates with care and respect.

dialogues.speaker: Genzou
dialogues.text: Ever since I started serving Lord Terada, I've never spent another day maintaining order, risking my life amidst the horrors of war, or going hungry.

dialogues.speaker: Genzou
dialogues.text: There's no boss in the world who's better than him, so don't you dare make any trouble for him, you hear me?
